controls.name: C-7d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-19T10:34:24.500Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-19T11:34:24.500Z"
| WHERE host.name == "db-1" AND event.outcome == "success"
| STATS BY source.ip, user.name
| SORT source.ip, user.name
